title: 14th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/14/2/2025).
Unfinished business: continued debate on the government-sponsored Public Referendum Bill (on holding public votes to seek the people's opinion), submitted by Inguraidhoo MP Ibrahim Falah.

Continued debate on the State-Owned Enterprises Committee's report on the state of Maldives Marketing and Public Relations Corporation Ltd (MMPRC) and Maldives Integrated Tourism Development Corporation Ltd (MITDC).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to continue debating the Public Referendum Bill and the committee report on the state of MMPRC and MITDC.
